votes.motion: Approve Minutes from the April 26, 2022 City Council meeting.

Consideration of Resolution #2022-34, approving an agreement with Morgan Pavement Inc. for slurry seal application services for 2022. Dave Norman, Public Works Director, stated that the project will be in the Jordan Willows area.

Consideration of Preliminary subdivision approval for the Whisper Hollow Estates, a 20- lot residential project located at approximately 1700 West 1500 North. A representative from CTR Development was available to answer questions.
Consideration of Preliminary subdivision approval for Carla’s Cove, a 13-lot residential development located at 2402 West Main Street. Matthew Jorgenson was representing the applicant.
Consideration of Preliminary subdivision approval for Beck’s Landing, a 16-lot residential development located at 1080 North 2300 West. Matthew Jorgenson was representing the applicant.

Consideration of Ordinance #30-2022, the Johnston Zone Change, approximately 1- acre of property located at 2301 North 600 West changing the zoning from R-1-12 (residential) to R-1-8 (residential). John Johnston was representing the applicant. He stated that they are only developing 3 lots,
Consideration of Final subdivision approval of the Lehi Medical Phase 1, a one-lot subdivision with no improvements located at 3300 North 1200 West in a Commercial Zone.

Consideration of a Plat Amendment for the Ivory Ridge Plat C, amending lots 3A and 3B of Ivory Ridge Plat B located at 3412 North Center Street in the Ivory Ridge Planned Community. A representative from Ivory Development was available to answer questions.

Consideration of Final subdivision approval for Somerset Hills, a 6-lot residential development located at 795 East 760 North in an R-1-8 zone. Lehi City Council Meeting                        5                                      May 10, 2022 Mark Gaza was representing the applicant.

Consideration of Preliminary subdivision approval for Cold Spring Ranch MD4, a 90- lot residential development located at Mitchell Drive and Old Ranch Road. Jeff Stevenson was representing the applicant.

Consideration of Ordinance #29-2022, amendments to the Lehi City Development Code, revising areas where accessory dwelling units are not allowed.
